mainEntity.name: Why does representation scope matter in a representation matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: The practical point is that the first review works best when the objective, the current status, and the available facts are clear from the beginning. In real cases, representation scope changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
